title: SSO admin event enrichment and guaranteed delivery to external sinks
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Problem: SSO (SAML/OIDC) events that indicate admin activity (user create/deactivate, role/grant changes, SCIM provisioning responses, SSO configuration updates) are currently emitted into the general audit stream with minimal context. Security teams require these admin SSO events to be: 1) enriched with assertion metadata (IdP, assertion ID, relayed entities), 2) flagged for high-priority delivery to external SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog) and webhook sinks, and 3) delivered with strong durability semantics and traceability (request-level tracing, retries, and DLQ) so that compliance audits never miss critical admin actions.
background: Recent customer feedback and an internal incident revealed gaps: (a) SSO-triggered admin changes were delayed or dropped under burst load to audit forwarders, (b) lack of SAML assertion context made investigating user access changes slow, and (c) no separate SLO or SLA for admin/identity events. Existing audit forwarder work covers general delivery guarantees, but we need a focused path for SSO/admin events with enrichment, higher durability, and compliance-grade observability.
proposal: Introduce an SSO Admin Event pathway in the audit pipeline with: 1) enrichment service that appends SAML/OIDC assertion metadata and SCIM result context; 2) priority tagging so forwarders treat messages with elevated delivery semantics; 3) delivery modes: 'guaranteed' (at-least-once with idempotency and ordered windows) and 'expedited' (low-latency best-effort for UX); 4) mutual-TLS and token-based auth for webhooks to SIEMs and sink connectors; 5) an audit-dedicated DLQ and reconciliation job that cross-checks source master audit store vs sink ACKs and surfaces mismatches in the Console; 6) per-event tracing (trace-id correlation across enrichment, storage, and sink deliveries) and SLOs (delivery within 30s 99th percentile for expedited, 5m for guaranteed).
acceptance_criteria: SSO admin events include enriched fields: assertion_id, idp_entity, authn_instant, relay_state, scim_response_code
Forwarders classify messages with priority=admin and route them through the guaranteed delivery path
External webhook connectors support mTLS and include idempotency-key headers for deduplication
Reconciliation job detects and surfaces >99.95% parity over 24h between master audit store and configured SIEM sinks
End-to-end traces available in Console for admin events across enrichment -> storage -> sink delivery
Test harness demonstrates idempotent replay (no duplicate alerts in downstream SIEM) under retry storms
implementation_plan: 1) Schema: define 'sso_admin_v1' envelope additions and publish in schema registry (owner: Diego). 2) Enricher: lightweight service (k8s) that consumes audit stream, enriches SSO events and writes back to audit topic with priority tag (owner: Aisha). 3) Forwarder changes: add priority-based route and guaranteed delivery worker with per-sink sequencing checks and DLQ (owner: infra-forwarder team). 4) Webhook connector: add mTLS, idempotency-key header, exponential backoff with jitter, configurable retries and per-tenant rate limits (owner: connectors). 5) Reconciliation: scheduled job + Console dashboard showing parity and incidents (owner: observability). 6) Tests: unit + integration + chaos + perf and compliance signoff. 7) Rollout: feature-flagged, opt-in customers, monitor SLOs, then enable by default for enterprise tiers.

ENG: Implement enrichment service and container image build
INFRA: Add priority routing and guaranteed worker to forwarder
CONNECTORS: Implement mTLS and idempotency headers for webhook sink
OBS: Build reconciliation job, parity dashboards, and alerting rules
SECOPS: Threat model and KMS review for transport auth
QA: Create test harness for jittered retries and duplicate-detection tests
DOCS: Update Console docs and customer-runbook for configuring SSO admin sinks
risks: 1) Increased tail latency for guaranteed path under high load — mitigated by autoscaling and prioritized resource pools. 2) Complexity of enrichment service adding a write before forwarder: require transactional publish to master audit store to avoid gaps. 3) Integration complexity with customers' SIEMs requiring mTLS cert exchange — provide automated cert rotation docs and tooling. 4) Potential privacy concerns exposing assertion fields — will redact PII and include only assertion identifiers and IdP metadata per compliance policy.
testing_plan: Unit tests for enrichment transforms; integration tests against a test Splunk/Datadog endpoint and local webhook receiver; load test with 10k events/sec including 5% admin events to validate SLOs; chaos test that kills forwarder worker and ensures reconciliation recovers missing events; regression test for deduplication under replay.
metrics_and_slos: Delivery SLO (admin, guaranteed): 99.99% delivered to sink within 5 minutes
Trace coverage: 100% of admin events must have trace-id
DLQ rate alert: >0.01% admin events into DLQ in 1h triggers pager
security_review_notes: Requires formal security review: transport auth (mTLS), storage encryption for enriched fields, retention policy updates for assertion metadata. Coordinate with Security and Compliance to ensure PII redaction rules are applied and KMS integration is validated.
